sources.title: ornith-ai/Ornith-1.5-397B-FP8 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Ornith-1.5-397B is a ~397B mixture-of-experts model (≈800 GB in bf16), so multi-GPU serving is required. The recipes below use 8-way tensor parallelism on a single node (e.g., 8× H200 141GB); adjust --tensor-parallel-size / --tp to match your hardware, or use FP8/INT4 quantized builds for smaller deployments.

sources.title: Ornith-1.5: From Self-Scaffolding to Self-Improvement
sources.snippet: Ornith-1.5 extends the self-scaffolding framework introduced in Ornith-1.0 into a more complete self-improvement loop: the model proposes new tasks, generates task-specific scaffolds, and produces solution rollouts for reinforcement learning, continuously creating new learning experiences from which it can improve.

sources.title: Ornith AI - Open-Source Agentic Coding Models
sources.snippet: Ornith AI guide for self-scaffolding open-source coding models: model sizes, VRAM, benchmarks, local setup, use cases, and agentic coding workflows.

sources.title: Ornith-1.5 open models launch in 397B, 35B, and 9 B sizes.
sources.snippet: DeepReinforce released Ornith-1.5 in 397B, 35B and 9B scales, with a training loop that generates its own tasks, scaffolds and rollouts.
